summary: Iteration 2 regression + new features round. Backend: 26 passed / 1 skipped (env-specific). Added 7 new pytest cases for org logo upload, public-image endpoint, channels list/create/message, empty-channel rejection, file rename (owner + forbidden non-owner), note-image upload. Frontend: Verified via Playwright end-to-end -- WebSocket bug fix (live chat immediate append), admin owner tabs on Northwind Studio (tab-permissions & tab-org both visible, non-owner permission toggle persists), org logo upload flows into Header (org-logo img with /api/public-image URL), folder creation + folder tabs, file rename (toast 'File renamed'), channel create + message isolation between channels, circular avatar (rounded-full), Notes image toolbar (fmt-image + note-image-input + note-content-editable all present). No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 845 lines -- consider splitting routers (notes, files, channels, orgs) into separate modules for maintainability
channels endpoint stores channels but there is no DELETE/rename endpoint -- future enhancement
org logo upload does not enforce content-type/size limits; consider validating image mime and max size to prevent abuse
public-image endpoint has no rate limit; consider caching-headers already present but rate-limiting recommended
seed_data_creation: Test data created via API and prefixed 'TEST_' / 'TESTF' -- not cleaned automatically for logo/channels/folders
context_for_next_testing_agent: WebSocket endpoint is @app.websocket('/api/ws') with ?token= query param. Chat optimistic append works via id-dedupe in ChatPanel.jsx. Admin sees Team/Permissions tabs only on orgs where they are owner/admin (must switch org to Northwind Studio; admin is only MEMBER of Blue Harbor). All new features (org logo, channels, folders, file rename, note images, circular avatars) verified functional end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A -- no regressions found this iteration. Previous WS bug (chat requires refresh) was caused by websocket being mounted at /ws (not under /api prefix), so ingress did not proxy it. Fix: moved to @app.websocket('/api/ws') + frontend WS_URL includes /api/ws. Verified working.
